claims.title: Sol high-region elimination and a finite proper actual-exit receiver

quoted_fields.interface: For the specified two ordered C3 ports with pair transfer and fixed positive rates,the source proves an actual return/reward operation from the ENTIRE simultaneous-high-anchor region to unbounded B={A<N or D<N},including arbitrary inventories,pair differences,anchor ratios and signed packet states. A finite proper exit-value H equal to old low receiver W_B on B then composes high-region elimination with the banked low central/star/phase1/terminal episodes at their original rate/cone scopes. The outgoing boundary trace remains open;full six-species and unrestricted recurrence are not proved.
quoted_fields.failure: New proofs same-principal author work,no independent audit. B is unbounded:one bounded anchor with an unbounded peer,large unpaired inventories and intermediate layers still need an outgoing coefficient-one negative receiving operation. Finiteness/polynomial bounds on actual returned W_B law plus nonnegative source reward do NOT supply that drift. No full diagnostic/unrestricted recurrence,global nonexplosion,practical value solver,advantage,priority or mission completion. Earlier accepted U1411/U1454 retain only their exact prior scopes.
